digest.component_or_area: Jira DC capability mapping CI job and contract framework
propositions: An on-demand GitHub Actions workflow (dispatch-only, never on push/PR/schedule) boots the digest-pinned Jira DC image and interrogates its capabilities via REST API, producing a committed environment contract as structured data with traceable raw request/response evidence for each claim.

The mapping job validates four independent vocabulary classes (issue types/workflows/statuses, priorities, link types with direction flags, and field name mappings) against hardcoded constants in rebar, reporting present/absent/present-but-different verdicts rather than mutating configuration.

Five length limits (summary, label, description, comment character counts) are measured empirically at limit-1/limit/limit+1 on the live instance, with read-back verification to detect silent truncation, and the configurable instance property jira.text.field.character.limit is recorded instead of assumed.

The image digest is derived from the Dockerfile's FROM line at job construction time and committed as asserted metadata in the capability map artifact and documentation, preventing staleness misdetection after image re-pins.

Link type direction validation includes an end-to-end write/read-back experiment for symmetric relations to catch inversion errors that would be invisible to presence-only checks, with evidence recorded showing inward/outward name interpretations.
The tool is classified and enforced as an authoring/spike instrument producing committed data reviewed before landing, not as a test-harness component that re-derives answers at runtime.
